label: LoadDeviceState
info:
Reads Load Device State from registers:
- 626: Day load energy (0.1kWh)
- 627-628: Total load energy (0.1kWh, U32)
- 740-743 + 796-799: UPS Load phase powers (1W, U32)
- 744-746: Load phase voltages (0.1V)
- 750-753 + 756-759: Load phase powers (1W, S32)
- 755: Load frequency (0.01Hz)

Triggers:
1. RPC: getLoadDeviceState

name: Prepare read (Daily/Total 626-628)
Prepare read (UPS Low 740-743)
Prepare read (UPS High 796-799)
Prepare read (Voltage 744-746)
Prepare read (Load Low 750-753)
Prepare read (Load High 756-759)
Prepare read (Freq 755)
Build LoadDeviceState JSON
Prepare RPC Response
THREE-PHASE: RPC only - Phase A/B/C voltages and powers (Load + UPS Load) with S32/U32
